title: Building a faster preview workflow
content:
Good templates deserve a fast feedback loop. This example shows how to turn a Blogger template into a real preview without waiting for a full deployment.

Start with the source

Keep src/template.xml as the single source of truth. The compiler reads sections, widgets and data expressions directly from the template, so the preview always reflects the markup you will publish.

Work in small steps

  • Edit a widget, then check the matching preview page immediately.
  • Use the layout editor to move sections without rewriting XML by hand.
  • Save changes only after the preview and validation results look right.
Short loops make design decisions easier to verify and cheaper to undo.

The result is a workflow that feels like working on a normal site while still respecting the structure of a Blogger template.
